title: AI & Machine Learning Research Intern
eligibility: B.Tech / B.E (CSE / IT / ECE), BCA / MCA, M.Tech with strong Python foundation
description: Join our AI research and automation team to build cutting-edge production systems. You will work on deep neural networks, computer vision (YOLO), Transformer architectures, and production RAG agents.
responsibilities: ["Develop and evaluate Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) vector pipelines", "Fine-tune lightweight open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral) for domain tasks", "Train computer vision models for object detection and bounding-box segmentation", "Write production-ready Python FastAPI microservices with Docker containerization"]
requirements: ["Strong command of Python 3.10+ and Object-Oriented Programming", "Hands-on experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face, or OpenCV", "Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, or Qdrant)", "Passion for building real-world AI applications that solve practical problems"]

title: Full Stack Web Engineering Intern
eligibility: B.Tech / B.E, BCA / MCA, B.Sc Computer Science students or recent graduates
description: Architect modern web apps with React 18, Tailwind CSS, Python FastAPI / Node.js, and automated cloud deployments. You will contribute to live client web platforms and internal SaaS tools.
responsibilities: ["Build reactive, accessible UI components in React 18 with Tailwind CSS", "Develop high-performance RESTful APIs in Python FastAPI or Node.js", "Design normalized relational database schemas in PostgreSQL and MySQL", "Write automated unit tests and participate in agile GitHub pull request reviews"]
requirements: ["Solid proficiency in modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3", "Understanding of React component state, hooks, and client-side routing", "Experience consuming and designing REST APIs", "Familiarity with Git version control, branching, and pull requests"]

title: Data Analytics & Power BI Intern
eligibility: Students or graduates in CSE, IT, Statistics, Mathematics, or Business Analytics
description: Transform complex datasets into interactive executive dashboards with advanced SQL, DAX formulas, and automated ETL workflows.
responsibilities: ["Design executive Power BI and Tableau dashboards with dynamic DAX calculations", "Write optimized SQL queries, views, and stored procedures for data aggregation", "Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) using Python Pandas and NumPy", "Build automated data ingestion scripts connecting APIs to SQL reporting warehouses"]
requirements: ["Strong SQL skills (joins, window functions, aggregations, subqueries)", "Proficiency in Microsoft Power BI, DAX, and data modeling", "Working knowledge of Python (Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn)", "Strong analytical mindset with sharp attention to metric precision"]

title: Python Automation & Workflow Intern
eligibility: B.Tech / B.E, BCA / MCA, or passionate self-taught Python developers
description: Develop high-throughput asynchronous backend APIs, event queues, and business automation workflows using Python, n8n, and webhooks.
responsibilities: ["Build asynchronous API endpoints using FastAPI and AsyncIO", "Develop self-healing n8n automation workflows connecting webhooks to CRMs", "Implement background task queues with Redis and Celery", "Automate recurring business procedures and data synchronization pipelines"]
requirements: ["Solid command of Python data structures and AsyncIO concepts", "Understanding of HTTP methods, headers, webhooks, and REST principles", "Familiarity with relational databases and SQL", "Problem-solving curiosity and self-driven learning attitude"]

title: Java Enterprise Microservices Intern
eligibility: B.Tech / B.E (CSE / IT), MCA students with strong Core Java foundation
description: Implement robust microservices architectures, Spring Boot services, secure REST endpoints, and transactional data layers.
responsibilities: ["Develop enterprise REST services with Spring Boot and Spring Data JPA", "Implement transactional database operations with Hibernate and PostgreSQL", "Configure Spring Security, JWT token validation, and role-based endpoints", "Package microservices into Docker containers for cloud staging deployment"]
requirements: ["Strong foundations in Core Java (Collections, Streams, Multithreading, OOP)", "Familiarity with Spring Boot and Maven / Gradle project setups", "Knowledge of relational database design and SQL queries", "Eagerness to learn enterprise software design patterns"]

title: Cyber Security & SOC Defense Intern
eligibility: Engineering or Computer Science students specializing in Cyber Security or Networks
description: Hands-on vulnerability assessments, ethical penetration testing, packet analysis, and security incident investigations.
responsibilities: ["Conduct automated and manual vulnerability scans on web applications (OWASP Top 10)", "Analyze network traffic packets using Wireshark for anomalous signatures", "Assist in configuring firewalls, SSL/TLS certificates, and reverse proxies", "Draft clear vulnerability triage reports with remediation recommendations"]
requirements: ["Understanding of TCP/IP networking, DNS, and OSI layer protocols", "Familiarity with Linux command line and tools (Kali, Nmap, Burp Suite)", "Understanding of common web application vulnerabilities (XSS, SQLi, CSRF)", "Strong commitment to ethical standards and confidentiality"]
